measurand_or_objective: Serialized DUT identity, configuration and reference plane
required_condition_sweep: All test configurations
mandatory_artifacts: identity record; configuration snapshot; reference-plane drawing
acceptance_rule: Unique identity and configuration continuity required

measurand_or_objective: Optical pulse repetition rate and variation
required_condition_sweep: Declared operating range and temperature
mandatory_artifacts: raw timing data; calculation; uncertainty budget
acceptance_rule: Report value/distribution with uncertainty; proof/system limit TBD

measurand_or_objective: Mean photon number for signal, weak-decoy and vacuum classes
required_condition_sweep: Each class; repetition rate; temperature; drive setting
mandatory_artifacts: raw power/count data; calibration chain; calculation; uncertainty
acceptance_rule: Measured ordering including uncertainty must be compatible with approved proof

measurand_or_objective: Intensity distribution, stability and drift
required_condition_sweep: Class, time, temperature and representative duty cycle
mandatory_artifacts: time series; distribution; drift model; uncertainty
acceptance_rule: Distribution/bounds required; numeric stability limit TBD

measurand_or_objective: Photon-number statistical nature
required_condition_sweep: Each non-vacuum intensity and representative conditions
mandatory_artifacts: HBT raw coincidences; corrections; fitted statistic; uncertainty
acceptance_rule: Compatibility with selected source/security model; numeric criterion TBD

measurand_or_objective: Source emission temporal profile and source timing jitter
required_condition_sweep: Intensity/state/temperature/drive sweep
mandatory_artifacts: waveform/time tags; instrument response; deconvolution; uncertainty
acceptance_rule: State/intensity distinguishability and system timing limits TBD

measurand_or_objective: Wavelength, spectral profile and linewidth
required_condition_sweep: Intensity/state/temperature/drive sweep
mandatory_artifacts: spectra; calibration; centre/width calculation; uncertainty
acceptance_rule: Compatibility with detector/filter and side-channel proof; numeric band TBD

measurand_or_objective: Inter-pulse phase distribution, independence and correlation
required_condition_sweep: Clock rate, drive, temperature, all intensity classes
mandatory_artifacts: interference raw data; estimator; correlation analysis; uncertainty; proof mapping
acceptance_rule: Bound must be approved against selected proof; uniformity may not be assumed

measurand_or_objective: H/V/D/A state preparation matrix, extinction and fidelity/error
required_condition_sweep: State, intensity, wavelength, temperature and representative geometry
mandatory_artifacts: raw analyser data; calibrated transfer model; state estimates; uncertainty
acceptance_rule: Proof-mapped state-dependent bounds TBD

measurand_or_objective: Basis/intensity-correlated spectral, temporal, spatial and polarization leakage
required_condition_sweep: All states/intensities across operating envelope
mandatory_artifacts: state-labelled raw data; distinguishability metrics; uncertainty; threat mapping
acceptance_rule: Acceptable distinguishability/leakage bound TBD by security proof

measurand_or_objective: Observed intensity/state selection frequencies and control-log integrity
required_condition_sweep: Representative run lengths and failure modes
mandatory_artifacts: selection logs; entropy source identity; health-test records; statistical analysis
acceptance_rule: Probabilities/configuration and randomness assurance require approval

measurand_or_objective: Source parameter dependence over operating envelope
required_condition_sweep: Temperature, humidity, supply, drive and duty-cycle envelope
mandatory_artifacts: environment log; parameter surfaces; uncertainty; out-of-limit behavior
acceptance_rule: Operating envelope and recalibration triggers TBD

measurand_or_objective: Serialized detector-system identity, channel map and configuration
required_condition_sweep: All detector channels and operating modes
mandatory_artifacts: identity record; channel map; firmware/config snapshot; reference plane
acceptance_rule: Unique identity and configuration continuity required

measurand_or_objective: Detector gate repetition rate, duration and efficiency profile
required_condition_sweep: Channel, temperature, bias and gate settings
mandatory_artifacts: timing raw data; profile; calibration; uncertainty
acceptance_rule: Profile and timing budget compatibility TBD

measurand_or_objective: Intrinsic dark-count probability/rate
required_condition_sweep: Channel, temperature, bias/gate/hold-off and duration
mandatory_artifacts: blocked-input time tags/counts; separation method; uncertainty
acceptance_rule: Operating-point-specific maximum TBD

measurand_or_objective: Conditional first/all/total after-pulse probability versus delay/history
required_condition_sweep: Channel, temperature, bias/gate, rate and hold-off
mandatory_artifacts: time tags; illuminated/non-illuminated gates; fit; uncertainty
acceptance_rule: History-dependent bound and operating limit TBD

measurand_or_objective: System photon-detection efficiency
required_condition_sweep: Channel, wavelength, polarization, temperature, bias/gate and count rate
mandatory_artifacts: incident photon calibration; corrected counts; uncertainty
acceptance_rule: Minimum/uncertainty and model mapping TBD

measurand_or_objective: Detection-efficiency linearity over photon flux/count-rate range
required_condition_sweep: Channel, wavelength, temperature, bias/gate and history
mandatory_artifacts: efficiency versus flux; linearity factor; uncertainty
acceptance_rule: Accepted operating range and factor TBD

measurand_or_objective: Detection-efficiency dependence on input polarization
required_condition_sweep: Channel, wavelength, temperature, bias/gate
mandatory_artifacts: polarization-resolved efficiency map; uncertainty
acceptance_rule: Mismatch bound and proof treatment TBD

measurand_or_objective: Dead, reset, partial-recovery and recovery times
required_condition_sweep: Channel, rate, temperature, bias/gate and hold-off
mandatory_artifacts: two-pulse raw data; recovery curve; uncertainty
acceptance_rule: Rate/history operating limit TBD

measurand_or_objective: Detector signal jitter and detection-efficiency temporal profile
required_condition_sweep: Channel, photon arrival, wavelength, rate and gate position
mandatory_artifacts: TCSPC histogram; instrument response; FWHM/span; uncertainty
acceptance_rule: Temporal gate and security limit TBD

measurand_or_objective: Spectral responsivity/detection efficiency versus wavelength
required_condition_sweep: Channel, wavelength, polarization and temperature
mandatory_artifacts: wavelength-resolved efficiency; calibration; uncertainty
acceptance_rule: Compatibility with source/filter and proof TBD

measurand_or_objective: Saturation, twilight, recovery and history dependence under elevated input
required_condition_sweep: Approved safe input envelope only; channel and settings
mandatory_artifacts: input calibration; state/event logs; recovery; uncertainty; safety record
acceptance_rule: Safe test envelope and fail-closed response TBD and authority-controlled

measurand_or_objective: Abnormal-input monitoring, alarms and fail-closed behavior
required_condition_sweep: Approved non-damaging abnormal conditions only
mandatory_artifacts: threat cases; alarm/state logs; timing; recovery; independent review
acceptance_rule: Threat-based acceptance and authority approval TBD

measurand_or_objective: Time-tag latency, resolution, clock provenance and event schema
required_condition_sweep: All channels, rates and clock states
mandatory_artifacts: time tags; clock/calibration records; loss-of-time cases; uncertainty
acceptance_rule: End-to-end timing tolerance TBD

measurand_or_objective: Background count response with representative receiver/FOV/filter/gate
required_condition_sweep: Receiver configuration, sky state, wavelength, pointing and time
mandatory_artifacts: radiance/configuration/time-aligned counts; uncertainty
acceptance_rule: Cannot close in component-only laboratory campaign
